fact_text: An exemption tied to section 99, which creates a tax event when property is transferred, was not renewed in 2024, and the speaker hoped for clarity on it in 2025.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Will Budget 2026 Save or Squeeze Pakistan's Real Estate Sector? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-29)

fact_text: Real estate stakeholders expected reforms to the section 236 transfer tax in the budget, as the proposals they submitted to the government.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Will Budget 2026 Save or Squeeze Pakistan's Real Estate Sector? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-29)

fact_text: For a filer, property transaction costs run from a minimum of about 10% to about 14% of the gross value of a constructed property.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Will Budget 2026 Save or Squeeze Pakistan's Real Estate Sector? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-29)

fact_text: Moving property gains from a 15% rate straight to the 35 to 45% normal tax rate would be too sudden; the speaker said a multi-year roadmap should phase the change in.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Will Budget 2026 Save or Squeeze Pakistan's Real Estate Sector? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-29)

fact_text: The cabinet agreed to remove the 3% FED on property, and the speaker expected the notification to follow in the budget.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Will Budget 2026 Save or Squeeze Pakistan's Real Estate Sector? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-29)

fact_text: Overseas Pakistanis and dual nationals should not face section 236 tax when buying a home, the speaker argued, so that remittances can flow into property.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Will Budget 2026 Save or Squeeze Pakistan's Real Estate Sector? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-29)

fact_text: Under a first-home principle, capital gains tax on selling a first home should be waived or deferred, and reinvesting a 500 sq yd plot into a 1,000 sq yd property should defer it, the speaker said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Will Budget 2026 Save or Squeeze Pakistan's Real Estate Sector? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-29)

fact_text: Non-residents selling property and repatriating the proceeds should receive exemptions so that they face no tax issues, the speaker argued.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Will Budget 2026 Save or Squeeze Pakistan's Real Estate Sector? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-29)

fact_text: Section 236 charges the buyer 3% on property valued up to 50 million, 3.5% between 50 and 100 million, and 4% above 100 million, and the seller pays the same rates.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Will Budget 2026 Save or Squeeze Pakistan's Real Estate Sector? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-29)

fact_text: The buyer pays 2% stamp duty on a property purchase, and the seller pays 1% town tax on the sale.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Will Budget 2026 Save or Squeeze Pakistan's Real Estate Sector? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-29)

fact_text: Property held by an owner carries a deemed rental income tax of 1% of its FBR value each year.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Will Budget 2026 Save or Squeeze Pakistan's Real Estate Sector? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-29)

fact_text: Developers pass tax costs to clients through documentation charges, which the speaker said rose from about 10 lakh to 20 lakh and then 30 lakh in the same sector.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Will Budget 2026 Save or Squeeze Pakistan's Real Estate Sector? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-29)

fact_text: Real estate was described as the largest employer in Pakistan, so the speaker said the budget's treatment of the sector matters for jobs.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Will Budget 2026 Save or Squeeze Pakistan's Real Estate Sector? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-29)

fact_text: Global valuation standards for real estate would attract international firms to invest in projects, the speaker argued, but work on them should begin soon.
